videos.noCierres: Don't close the tab or leave the panel until it finishes.

reemplazar.mensaje: The current file is deleted once the new one finishes uploading. Anyone with the lesson open will see the new one after reloading it.

faltas.noMp4: {{archivo}} is not an MP4: the video must be an .mp4 file.
faltas.noVtt: {{archivo}} is not a WebVTT file: the subtitles must be a .vtt file.

errores.muyGrande: The file is over the limit the platform accepts.
errores.noExiste: That key no longer exists in the imported content. Reload the page.

clave.inactivo: That account is deactivated: its password can't be reset.

que.instructor: Takes the course and uses the panel: graduations, videos and CSV.
que.admin: Everything an instructor does, plus account and QOS administration.

usuario.notaBaja: Deactivated: they can't sign in. It is reactivated with apolo-training-admin on the practice VM.
usuario.qosPendiente: Passed the course: their normal QOS is still pending (Passed, waiting for QOS tab).
usuario.noExisteTexto: There is no user “{{username}}” on the platform.
